svg.title: High-level architecture of the AquaControl smart water motor app
svg.desc: Three-layer architecture diagram: Mobile App layer, Cloud/Backend layer, and Hardware layer, showing how Flutter app, NestJS backend, EMQX MQTT broker, PostgreSQL, Redis, Firebase FCM, and ESP32 device interconnect.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the Flutter mobile app layer')
sendPrompt('How does authentication work in the app?')
sendPrompt('How does real-time state work in the Flutter app?')
sendPrompt('How does BLE provisioning work in the app?')
sendPrompt('Tell me about the NestJS backend API server')
sendPrompt('How does the auth service work with JWT and RBAC?')
sendPrompt('How does the EMQX MQTT broker work?')
sendPrompt('How does Firebase FCM push notification work?')
sendPrompt('Tell me about the PostgreSQL and TimescaleDB setup')
sendPrompt('What is Redis used for in this architecture?')
sendPrompt('What is Cloudflare R2 used for?')
sendPrompt('How is TLS/SSL handled?')
sendPrompt('How does multi-tenancy work for multiple societies?')
sendPrompt('How does role-based access control work?')
sendPrompt('How does the audit log work?')
sendPrompt('How does OTA firmware update work?')
sendPrompt('Tell me about the ESP32 firmware design')
sendPrompt('How does the MQTT client work on the ESP32?')
sendPrompt('How does the ESP32 local rule engine work offline?')
sendPrompt('How does the ESP32 watchdog and fail-safe work?')
sendPrompt('How does the relay controller work?')
sendPrompt('How do the ultrasonic tank level sensors work?')
sendPrompt('How does the ACS712 current sensor detect dry run?')
sendPrompt('What are the float switches used for?')
